=== YOUR SEGMENT'S NOTES (segment 1: The Keeper’s Watch) ===
--- NOTE: 1 The Keeper's Watch - Aside - The log ---
# 1 The Keeper's Watch - Aside - The log

The log was read by nobody until a ship was lost.[^1]
Then they read every page.[^2]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "The log was read by nobody until a ship was lost."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "read every page"

--- NOTE: 1 The Keeper's Watch ---
# 1 The Keeper's Watch

The watch began at dusk.[^1]
He trimmed the wick every four hours.[^2]
He logged the weather in a book.[^3]

[^1]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "The watch began at dusk."
[^2]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "trimmed the wick every four hours"
[^3]: [[Lighthouses - Ch 2 - Keepers of the Lamp#The Keeper’s Watch]] "logged the weather in a book"

=== END YOUR SEGMENT'S NOTES (segment 1: The Keeper’s Watch) ===

=== KEPT LOSSES ===
Loss 1.1

Run 1: The keeper kept a weather log.
- Quote: "logged the weather in a book"
- Why: it says what the log held

Run 2: The weather went into a book.
- Quote: "logged the weather in a book"

Loss 1.2

Run 2: Inspectors read the log only after a wreck.
- Quote: "read by nobody until a ship was lost"
- Quote: "Then the inspectors read every page."
- Why: it says who read the log
=== END KEPT LOSSES ===
